claims.claim: Independent S&P Global Market Intelligence research dated 2026-08-27 reports Visible Alpha consensus for Pentair 2026 net sales down 5.8% year over year to $3.9B, with Pool sales expected down 19.8% to $1.3B; it attributes the pressure to Pool channel inventory correction, weak housing conditions and higher interest rates, while Flow revenue is expected to rise 7% to $1.1B.

Reuters independently reported on 2026-07-28 that Pentair's second-quarter sales declined amid reduced U.S. housing demand and pool-equipment destocking and that Pentair agreed to acquire Taco Group Holdings for $1.4B.

risks.risk: Independent evidence corroborates that Pool weakness is not merely an issuer framing issue: housing/rate pressure and channel destocking materially depress 2026 revenue expectations.

unknowns.unknown: The independent sources do not establish whether Pool normalization will occur on management's expected timetable or whether Taco integration will realize projected economics.
